name: print-social-poster-set-y2k-pastel-dreamscape-shapes
title: Pastel Y2K 'Digital Dreamscape' poster set
whatItIs: Four vertical posters on a soft green-to-lavender gradient, each featuring a different white Y2K-style abstract graphic (flower burst, crescent moon with rings, grid cluster, ornate arch) with a small 'DIGITAL DREAMSCAPE' label.
whatItMeans: Varying one abstract white motif per poster while holding the gradient and label constant builds a cohesive four-piece series that still offers distinct standalone visuals.
techniques: render all decorative motifs in flat white against a soft gradient for a dreamy, ethereal consistency
vary the featured motif per poster (organic vs. celestial vs. architectural) to keep a series from feeling repetitive
keep text minimal and small so abstract graphics remain the dominant visual element
bestFor: poster series for music or fashion events

vocabulary.definition: a design style referencing late-1990s/early-2000s digital visuals: chrome, outline stars, bubble shapes
